programs.name: Select (Evaluation -> Select Flex or Select Daily funded)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (updates at end of day, enforced in real time). Funded: locks at $50,100 when EOD balance reaches $52,100 or on first payout request.
programs.consistency_rule: Evaluation: no single day may be more than 40% of total profit (optional 50% add-on, priced $205 for 50K). Funded: none.
programs.payout_frequency: Select Flex: every 5 winning days ($150+ each). Select Daily: daily eligibility.
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K funded, minimum payout $250. Flex: up to 50% of profits, capped at $2,500 per payout (accounts bought after Sep 1, 2026; $3,000 before), no DLL, no buffer. Daily: up to 2x profit since last payout, capped at $1,250 (after Sep 1, 2026; $1,000 before), $1,000 DLL, $2,100 buffer. Funded contracts start at 2 minis, scale to 3 at $1,500 and 4 at $2,000 EOD profit. Must be net positive for the cycle. The Flex/Daily choice is permanent per account.
programs.notes: No DLL during the evaluation. 50K accounts bought before the new dashboard keep a $2,500 profit target. Select 300K exists as a limited release ($449).

programs.name: Growth (Evaluation -> Growth Sim Funded)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (enforced in real time against net liquidation value); funded locks at $50,100
programs.consistency_rule: None in evaluation; 35% consistency rule on every funded payout request
programs.payout_frequency: When eligible: at least 5 trading days with $150+ profit since the last payout
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K funded (bought on/after Sep 12, 2025): balance must be at least $53,000; minimum payout $500; max per request $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 (payout 4 onward). Paid in 24-48 hours.
programs.notes: DLL of $1,250 is a soft breach (stops trading for the day, does not fail). 50K accounts bought before Sep 12, 2025 allowed 5 contracts.

programs.name: Lightning Funded (instant funding)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (enforced in real time); locks at $50,100
programs.consistency_rule: Progressive: 20% for the 1st payout, 25% for the 2nd, 30% for later payouts (accounts bought after Sep 12, 2025)
programs.payout_frequency: No minimum trading days; request once the profit goal and consistency rule are met
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K profit goal $3,000 for payout 1 and $2,000 from payout 2 (resets after each payout). Minimum payout $1,000; maximum $2,000 for payouts 1-3, $2,500 from payout 4.
programs.notes: No evaluation and no resets; a failed account must be repurchased. DLL is a soft breach.

news_trading: Allowed: Tradeify states it has no rules against trading news events
ea_bots_allowed: Restricted: personal bots allowed if not HFT; trader must prove sole ownership (may require a live video of enabling it); using the same bot across multiple firms is against policy
copy_trading: Restricted: compliance FAQ lists 'prohibited trade-copying' as coordination and flags coordinated automation across unrelated accounts; no published rule on copying between your own accounts was found
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: positions must be closed by 4:45 PM ET each weekday (12:59 PM ET on holiday half-days); open positions are auto-closed at market close without failing the account; no weekend holding
restricted_countries_note: About 65 countries restricted by residency, including Bosnia & Herzegovina, Montenegro, Bulgaria, Albania, Turkey, Russia, Ukraine, Israel, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam and Pakistan. Serbia is not listed. US is not restricted. List: https://help.tradeify.co/en/articles/10495888-rules-restricted-countries
payout_methods: Rise (main method: ACH bank transfer, crypto, local currencies)
path_to_live: Tradeify Elite: 3 payouts on one account, or 10 total payouts since the last live transition, make a trader eligible for consideration (not automatic). Elite Live accounts: 80/20 split, daily payouts, EOD drawdown ($2,000 on 50K), no DLL, plus per-account Performance Reward Pools; up to 5 live accounts.

affiliate_program.commission: 15% on Growth and Select evaluations, 10% on Lightning Funded, $5 per reset, $5 per activation fee
affiliate_program.notes: Application form; $1,000 minimum affiliate payout via Plane, paid on the 15th; 60-day cookie, last click wins.

recent_changes_2026.change: New Select plan (3-day evaluation, Flex or Daily payout choice); live program rebranded Tradeify Elite with one live account per funded account that received a payout, no simulated-profit cap.
Tradeify 3.0: all plans one-time purchase only (no subscriptions), Select/Growth prices up about 3%, Select 50K target back to $3,000 for new accounts, Rithmic and Tradesea added.
Select 50K payout caps changed for new accounts: Flex cap $3,000 -> $2,500; Daily cap $1,000 -> $1,250.

pros: One-time purchase with no activation fees on any plan.
No consistency rule in Select funded accounts and no DLL in the Select evaluation or Select Flex funded account.
News trading is explicitly allowed; personal (non-HFT) bots allowed.
Wide platform choice across Tradovate and Rithmic.
cons: Per-payout caps on 50K ($1,250-$3,000 depending on plan and payout number).
Live (Elite) split is 80/20, lower than the 90/10 in sim funded.
Funded payouts require more than 50% of trades and profit from positions held over 10 seconds.
Long restricted-country list (about 65), including several Balkan countries.
Homepage pricing cards showed placeholder text and inconsistent prices on 2026-10-16; the help center pricing reference is the reliable source.
best_for: Futures traders who want a low one-time evaluation fee with no activation fee and a choice between 5-day or daily payouts.
